# GenAI Certification Catalog and Value Order

> 150 deduplicated credentials (132 active, 9 beta, 5 announced, 4 retired) reconciled across T0-29, T0-30, T0-31, T0-32, T0-34, T3-01, T3-02 and T0-11.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Partial Reduce Step R1 release (as of 2026-11-19):** Research pipeline 2 sessions **T0-28** (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft hyperscalers) and **T0-33** (developer tools, agentic suites and GitHub) are deferred past **2026-12-05**. The **17 entries** in those two groups are tagged *(provisional)* using T0-11, T3-01 and T3-02 and will be refreshed once T0-28 and T0-33 complete.

## How the value order works

Every credential in `data/credentials.json` is scored on six criteria as `[lo, mid, hi]` intervals (0–10) and ranked via deterministic Monte Carlo simulation (4,000 triangular draws, seed `20261119`) [M · decision D-026]. Read rank intervals (`P10–P90`) rather than point ranks: overlapping intervals mean two credentials are indistinguishable given current evidence.

| Criterion | Base weight | Meaning |
|---|:---:|---|
| `hiring_signal` | 30% | Measured share in large systematic job-posting audits (0–10 calibrated to the observed market ceiling where ~10% of target-role postings = 8.5–9.5). Left null whenever only small convenience samples or vendor claims exist; scripts/rank_credentials.py omits null hiring_signal and re-normalises the remaining five weights to sum to 1.0. |
| `channel_value` | 20% | Partner-programme tier counts, FDE gates, SI/client staffing clauses and employer capability mandates. |
| `rigour` | 15% | Proctoring, live hands-on lab/practical assessment, public verification, renewal rules and resistance to brain-dumps or LLM assistance. |
| `skill_alignment` | 15% | Coverage of Must and Important skills for the target role families in data/skills_ontology.json. |
| `currency` | 10% | Blueprint recency (2025–2026 GenAI/agentic/governance updates) net of retirement or short-validity churn risk. |
| `cost_efficiency` | 10% | Inverse of exam/bundle fee and preparation-hour burden (lower cash and time cost scores higher). |

- **Transparent re-normalisation:** Only **9 of 150** credentials have a systematic large-sample posting measurement (seven governance/security credentials from Axial Search's n = 1,997 US AI-governance dataset [C · T0-34 L51], plus CKA and CKAD from LinuxCareers' n = 1,675 Linux posting audit [B · T0-32 L395]). For the remaining **141 credentials**, `hiring_signal` is `null` and the script re-normalises the other five weights to sum to 1.0 rather than inventing numbers from ten-posting convenience samples.
- **Decision rule first:** Rankings show relative quality *conditional on deciding to certify*. Before paying for any exam, apply the three-condition filter and stop-loss in [credential-roi.md](credential-roi.md).
- **Conflict-of-interest (COI) tags:** Entries tagged *(COI)* draw facts from vendor-primary pages or (for Anthropic in T0-29) an issuer-affiliated research run; key Anthropic exam logistics and the US Department of War supply-chain litigation (T0-29 L83) were independently live-verified on 2026-11-19.

## Channel lenses

Value depends heavily on employer channel. A credential that unlocks partner tiers in an SI practice may be inaccessible or ignored at a product startup.

- **Provisional hyperscaler and dev-tool rows (17 entries):** AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft and GitHub records carry `provisional_pending_rp2: true` and draw on T0-11, T3-01 and T3-02 until RP2 sessions T0-28 and T0-33 run after 2026-12-05.
- **Sparse hiring-signal denominators:** Only 9 of 150 credentials have systematic large-sample posting rates (Axial Search US AI-governance n = 1,997, unstable snapshots across 2026 [C · T0-34 L51, L61]; LinuxCareers n = 1,675 Linux-focused postings [B · T0-32 L395]). Every other credential is ranked via five-criterion re-normalisation; convenience-sample counts (such as Salesforce 7/17 US, 12/17 India or Palantir 8/14 US in T0-31) are documented in notes rather than converted into synthetic hiring-signal scores.
- **NVIDIA `NCP-GENL` and `NCP-AAI` registration conflict:** Recorded as `announced` (V0) following T0-32 K2 (exam pages displayed `(Coming soon)` beside Register on 2026-10-30 while the hub listed USD 200 [A · T0-32 L74, L631, L841–L842]) and a 2026-11-19 live check confirming mixed portal status alongside rolling Certiverse scheduling. Verify live Certiverse availability before paying for prep.
- **Anthropic COI and US defence exclusion (V0):** T0-29 carried model-issuer COI on Anthropic's four Claude exams; partner gating, fees, December 2026 refresh dates and the exclusion of CCAO-F from partner tiers were independently live-verified on 2026-11-19, alongside the split US litigation over the Department of War FASCSA supply-chain designation (D.C. Circuit 2–1 panel ruling 2026-09-25, rehearing en banc petition filed 2026-10-13 [A · T0-29 L83]).
- **Unverified private credential bodies and Indian ed-tech programmes:** ARTiBA, GSDC (unverified ISO 17024 PCB-168 claim), Blockchain Council and IABAC had zero verified accreditation and 0/29 posting hits in T0-30 [A · T0-30 L71, L74]. Indian institute CEP/ed-tech bundles (₹1.3–2.3L) issue non-refundable certificates of participation with 0/14 India posting hits [A · T0-30 L71, L78].
- **Freshness:** Data as of 2026-11-19; earliest expiry is 2026-12-03 (driven by V0 items including beta exams, NVIDIA registration status and pending US litigation).
